name: Carrion Comfort
description: Survives by finding peace in the inevitability of decay and loss
behavioral_signature: Functional where others are paralyzed because they've already accepted the worst
under_stress: Acceptance becomes fatalism and they stop fighting to survive
at_rest: Calm, detached, at peace with entropy
will_always: function in horror that freezes others
will_never: be surprised by how bad things get
unless: something genuinely good happens and they don't know how to process it
